reference.notes:
I changed one expression in `parseURL` in `src/parse.ts`. The slash in front of a Windows drive letter is now removed only when the protocol is `file:`, in any letter case, and the drive letter comes first in the path. The regex is now anchored, `^\/(?=[A-Za-z]:)`, so anything that looks like a drive letter later in the path, in the search or in the hash is left alone. Every other URL keeps its pathname as written.

There was no `not implemented` stub in `src/parse.ts`; the old drive-letter code was still in place, so I edited that line directly. Nothing else changed, and the exports and their signatures are the same.

The full `npx vitest run` passes: 15 files and 588 tests, including both drive-letter suites (55 and 66 tests). ESLint and Prettier report no problems in `src/parse.ts`.
